pairs.registryProposal: Coverage: the map marks triggers-test governance 'weak', but the subject's precondition holds (two hooks and a modal keep IPC read responses past the call). Weak status comes from domain coverage of the context, not from this subject, so a weak row can hide a strongly-governed pair. Consider ranking pairs inside weak rows by subject precondition rather than skipping them wholesale. Separately, the transport auto-dedup in this repo keys eligibility on a verb regex (list|get|fetch), which silently excludes read verbs like 'browse'; in-flight-dedup could name verb-inferred eligibility as a failure mode beside opt-in dedup.
